name: The Ritz-Carlton, Marina del Rey
insider_take: The only AAA Five Diamond hotel in LA's largest man-made marina, where luxury meets the laid-back marina lifestyle just minutes from LAX.
whats_special: This waterfront gem sits in the world's largest man-made marina with over 5,000 boat slips. The hotel's Club Level occupies floors 8-20, offering stunning panoramic views of the Pacific Ocean, marina, and downtown LA skyline. The property features the only hotel-based yacht charter service in LA, and its location puts you just 4 miles from Venice Beach and 15 minutes from Beverly Hills.
pro_tip: Book an ocean-facing room on floors 15+ for unobstructed sunset views over the Pacific. The marina's calm waters create perfect reflections during golden hour – ideal for Instagram-worthy shots.
dont_miss: Take advantage of the complimentary shuttle to nearby beaches and shopping. The marina's waterfront dining scene is exceptional – walk to Salt Air for fresh seafood or catch the weekend farmers market at Burton Chace Park. The nearby Ballona Wetlands offer a surprising nature escape just minutes from the urban hustle.
pros: Stunning waterfront location with marina and ocean views
Exceptional Ritz-Carlton luxury service and amenities
Prime location near LAX airport and Venice Beach
Elegant rooms with floor-to-ceiling windows and modern furnishings
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects high-end positioning
Marina location may feel removed from central LA attractions
